title: Junior Backend Developer (Golang & PostgreSQL)
description:
Job Description: Junior Backend Developer (Go/Golang)

**Company:** Zorrro Deliveries Private Limited  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal (Work from Office)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Mon-Fri( 5days of working)  
**Department:** Engineering – Backend Development  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year

About Zorrro

Zorrro empowers businesses with innovative IT solutions, reliable EV rentals, and seamless logistics services designed to support modern business growth. We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals who are passionate about technology and eager to build their careers in backend development.

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Junior Backend Developer with knowledge of Go (Golang) and PostgreSQL** to join our engineering team in Kolkata. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, database management, REST API development, and problem-solving.

As a Junior Backend Developer, you will work closely with experienced engineers to develop, test, debug, and maintain backend services. This role is ideal for freshers and early-career developers who are eager to learn, contribute to real-world projects, and grow their software engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and enhance backend services and RESTful APIs using Go (Golang).
* Write efficient SQL queries and manage data using PostgreSQL.
* Design and maintain database tables, relationships, indexes, and constraints.
* Implement business logic, input validation, error handling, and logging.
* Write clean, readable, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Debug technical issues and assist in identifying and resolving software bugs.
* Write unit tests and support integration and API testing.
* Collaborate with frontend developers and other team members to deliver features.
* Use Git for version control and participate in code reviews.
* Follow backend development best practices related to security, performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Continuously learn new technologies and contribute to improving existing systems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Basic knowledge of **Go (Golang)**, including syntax, data types, functions, structs, interfaces, and error handling.
* Understanding of PostgreSQL and relational database concepts.
* Ability to write SQL queries involving filtering, JOINs, GROUP BY, and subqueries.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, JSON, and HTTP status codes.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with Git and version control.
* Good logical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Strong willingness to learn, accept feedback, and work collaboratively.
* Ability to work from our Kolkata office.

Good to Have

* Familiarity with Go modules and the Go standard library.
* Basic understanding of goroutines, channels, and concurrency.
* Exposure to Go frameworks or routers such as Gin, Echo, or Chi.
* Knowledge of database transactions, indexing, and query optimisation.
* Basic familiarity with Docker, Linux, and testing tools such as Postman.
* Personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions involving Go or PostgreSQL.

Eligibility Criteria

* Freshers and candidates with **0–1 year of experience** are welcome to apply.
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with equivalent practical knowledge and relevant projects are also encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should be willing to demonstrate their technical knowledge through practical assignments or technical interviews.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real-world backend development projects.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced developers.
* Hands-on exposure to API development, database design, testing, and debugging.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning and professional growth.
* Opportunities to strengthen your expertise in Go, PostgreSQL, and backend system design.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their **updated resume along with their GitHub profile or links to relevant projects**, if available.

**Email:** hr@zorrroservices.com

**Join Zorrro and build your career in backend engineering!**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Operation Manager - Backend Confectionery
description:
Job description:

Position: Operation Manager - Backend Confectionery

Department: Operations

Location: Dum Dum, Kolkata

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 2–5 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our Confectionery Division. The candidate will be responsible for managing production, inventory, quality, manpower, procurement coordination, dispatch, and overall operational efficiency while ensuring that products are delivered on time and meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage and supervise the overall day-to-day operations of the confectionery division.

\* Plan and monitor production schedules based on sales demand, orders, and inventory requirements.

\* Ensure smooth coordination between production, procurement, stores, sales, and dispatch teams.

\* Monitor the availability and consumption of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.

\* Maintain optimum inventory levels and minimize wastage, expiry, and stock losses.

\* Ensure compliance with quality, hygiene, food safety, and operational standards.

\* Monitor production output, productivity, wastage, and operational costs.

\* Supervise and manage production and support staff, including manpower allocation and shift planning.

\* Ensure proper maintenance and efficient utilization of production machinery and equipment.

\* Coordinate with the purchase team for timely procurement of raw materials and packaging materials.

\* Monitor batch production, stock movement, dispatch, and delivery schedules.

\* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

\* Maintain proper operational records, reports, stock statements, production reports, and MIS.

\* Work closely with the management to achieve production targets, sales requirements, and profitability goals.

\* Develop and implement SOPs to improve operational efficiency and standardization.

\* Monitor vendor and supplier performance and coordinate for timely resolution of operational issues.

\* Ensure proper housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards across the production and storage areas.

\* Handle customer/order-related operational requirements and ensure timely fulfillment.

\* Conduct regular operational reviews and provide reports to senior management.

\* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.

\* Required Skills

\* Strong knowledge of confectionery/food production operations.

\* Excellent operations and people-management skills.

\* Knowledge of inventory management and production planning.

\* Good understanding of quality control and food safety practices.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

\* Ability to manage multiple teams and coordinate across departments.

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills.

\* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

\* Strong leadership, decision-making, and organizational skills.

\* Knowledge of production machinery, maintenance coordination, and process improvement will be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

\* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Food Technology, Hotel Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

\* Relevant experience in the confectionery, bakery, FMCG, food production, or hospitality industry will be preferred.

Pay: ₹38,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Collibra - Gig
description:
Location: Kolkata

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 21, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744385

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics -Consultant — Collibra Data Intelligence Platform-GIG**

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with deep, hands-on expertise in the **Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** to lead the design, implementation and adoption of data governance capabilities across the enterprise. You will work directly with data owners, stewards, architects and business stakeholders to translate governance policy into a working Collibra implementation — operating model, metadata, lineage, workflows and data quality — and make it something the business actually uses.

This is a hands-on delivery role with strong client and stakeholder exposure. You will be equally comfortable configuring the platform and standing in front of a steering committee explaining why it matters.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and configuration of the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, including operating model design, communities, domains, asset types, relations, complex attributes and scopes.
* Design and build **Collibra workflows** (BPMN / Groovy) for data steward approvals, issue management, access requests and onboarding processes.
* Configure and manage the **Collibra Data Catalog**, business glossary, reference data and policy management modules.
* Implement technical and business lineage using **Collibra Lineage Harvester, Edge** and custom lineage ingestion.
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise source systems, data platforms and BI tools using the Collibra REST APIs, Edge connectors, Catalog connectors and JDBC ingestion.
* Define and operationalise data governance frameworks: roles and responsibilities, stewardship models, data ownership, policies and standards.
* Establish metadata ingestion pipelines and automate bulk metadata onboarding via APIs and import templates.
* Define and track data quality rules, KPIs and dashboards; support remediation of data quality issues with the relevant data owners.
* Support platform administration: user and group management, roles and permissions, environment promotion and release management.
* Run workshops, training and enablement sessions for stewards and business users to drive platform adoption.
* Produce solution design documents, configuration guides, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Provide advisory input on governance roadmap, maturity assessments and best practice to senior stakeholders.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **8+ years** of overall experience in data management, data governance or enterprise data platforms.
* **Proven, hands-on proficiency with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** — not just usage, but design and configuration across multiple implementations.
* Strong command of the Collibra operating model: asset types, domains, communities, attributes, relations, hierarchies and validation rules.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting Collibra workflows (BPMN, Groovy scripting).
* Experience with Collibra Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Helpdesk and Policy Manager.
* Working knowledge of Collibra Edge, Lineage Harvester and connector-based metadata ingestion.
* Solid experience with the Collibra REST API for automation, bulk operations and system integration.
* Strong SQL and a good understanding of data modelling, metadata management and data architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data privacy and regulatory drivers (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, CCPA).
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and written communication skills — able to work with both engineering teams and business leadership.
* Linux skills to manage the on-premise server components

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Collibra Data Quality (DQ)** — rule authoring, DQ job configuration, scorecards, and integration of DQ results back into the Collibra Data Catalog.
* **Python** — for API automation, metadata ingestion scripts and data quality validation.
* **Git** — version control for workflow artefacts, scripts and configuration-as-code; familiarity with branching strategies and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Snowflake** — cataloguing and lineage from Snowflake
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) and modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks).
* Experience with other governance or DQ tools (Informatica, Alation, Ataccama, Great Expectations) for comparative context.
* API Development with Spring Boot
* Consulting background with experience running client-facing engagements and pre-sales support.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
* **Collibra Ranger / Collibra Expert certification** strongly preferred (e.g. Collibra Certified Ranger, Data Steward, or Workflow Developer).

Certifications in Snowflake, cloud platforms or DAMA CDMP are an advantage.

  

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
